note: Wikidata q-ids only. Madrid is not in the old Explorer, so this city is written fresh rather than converted. No entrance is claimed: no door here has been measured, so every point is the centroid or area it actually is. CENTRE: Wikidata's point for the Justicia neighbourhood (Q1992319), chosen because the two obvious candidates both sit on a place in this seed. Madrid's own point (Q2807) is 23 m from the Puerta del Sol, because the city is measured from Kilometre Zero on that square; the Centro district's point (Q1763376) is 22 m from the Plaza Mayor. Either one would make the audit report a real monument as a centroid mistake, the same false positive Vienna produced with its cathedral. Justicia is central, sourced, and 596 m from the nearest place. DROPPED: Atocha station (Q5846989) graded D. It is the modern station complex, whose OpenStreetMap outline covers the whole site and lands 163 m away with no Wikipedia coordinate to back Wikidata up. The tropical garden a child would come for is in the old 1892 iron hall, which has no Wikidata item of its own, so there was nothing better to seed.

places.name: Museo Nacional de Ciencias Naturales
places.note: The building, not the institution. Q1966699 is the museum as an organisation; Q29477212 is the Palacio de las Artes y la Industria it occupies, about 80 m away, which is what a visitor walks up to.
